name: WOW! Internet, TV & Phone (WideOpenWest)
notes: Researched from public wowway.com help-center articles and the public WOW! login page only (no sign-in). The login page asks for 'Username (this may be your email)' and Password on one page, with Forgot Username, Forgot Password, Login, Sign in with Google and a register link, so identifier is email_or_username, loginSteps 1 and Google sign-in is offered (observed). The help center adds that the login uses the chosen Account Email, and that registering needs the last 4 digits of the account number, the account holder's last name and the service ZIP (registrationFields, added by the 2026-10-09 review). The online account manager is My Account; its Billing & Payment section holds Make a Payment / Submit Payment, WOW! AutoPay, Turn AutoPay Off and Paperless Statements. Ways to pay: AutoPay, one-time online payment, automated phone 1-866-496-9669, agent (fee charged, amount not stated), drop box or mail. AutoPay uses a bank account or credit card, must be set up 5 days before a billing period to apply to that bill, and does not stop paper statements; if a balance exists when enrolling, pay it first or the first draft covers both statements. Paperless Statements avoids the fee WOW! charges for paper statements (amount not stated) and needs an email confirmation. WOW! now offers YouTube TV for new TV customers; this record keeps legacy WOW! TV billing. How to cancel service is not documented in the help center pages found, so cancel_service is 'unknown' (the page asks the customer to contact customer service). Plans and fee amounts are left out. Integrated 2026-10-10: cancel_service 'unknown': the cancel page shows a neutral contact note instead of an online flow.

help.title: How can I pay my bill?
paragraphs: WOW! offers several ways to pay: AutoPay from a bank account or credit card each month; a one-time payment in My Account, WOW!'s online account manager; the automated phone system at 1-866-496-9669; an agent at the same number, which carries a fee; a secure local payment drop box; or a check or money order mailed with the payment stub in the envelope provided.

help.title: What is AutoPay and how do I manage it?
paragraphs: AutoPay deducts your monthly bill from your bank account or credit card. It does not stop paper statements; add Paperless Statements for that. Enroll at least 5 days before a billing period starts for that bill to be paid automatically; otherwise automatic payments begin with the following statement.

If you have a balance when you enroll, make a one-time payment for it under Make a Payment. If you do not, the first automatic payment covers the current balance plus the next statement and is taken on the first day of the next billing period.

To turn it on, sign in to My Account, open Billing & Payment, select WOW! AutoPay, enter your payment details, select Confirm and confirm again. Some offers include an AutoPay discount that starts on the next statement and stays while the payment method is in good standing.
steps: Open Billing & Payment and select WOW! AutoPay.
Enter your payment information and select Confirm.
Review your selections and confirm again.

help.title: Turn AutoPay off
paragraphs: Sign in to My Account, go to Billing & Payment and select Turn AutoPay Off, then select Turn AutoPay Off again on the confirmation screen. To use a different payment method instead, go to Billing & Payment and select Submit Payment.
steps: Open Billing & Payment and select Turn AutoPay Off.
Select Turn AutoPay Off again to confirm.

help.title: Paperless Statements
paragraphs: Paperless billing delivers your monthly bill online and avoids the fee WOW! charges for mailed paper statements. You get an email at your contact address when a statement is ready, then view, print and pay it in My Account.

To enroll, sign in, open Billing & Payment, select Paperless Statements and choose Enroll Me, then open the Paperless Statements Opt In Notification email and click its link to finish. To go back to paper, tick the unenroll box, confirm, and confirm the opt-out email; a paper bill can take up to 30 days to arrive.
steps: Open Billing & Payment and select Paperless Statements.
Confirm using the link in the opt-in email.

help.title: Signing in to My Account
paragraphs: Sign in with your WOW! ID: your username, which may be your email address, and your password, or use Sign in with Google. Use Forgot Username or Forgot Password on the login page if you cannot sign in, or register if you do not have a WOW! ID yet.

help.title: Registering and managing My Account
paragraphs: To register for online access you need the last four digits of your account number, the account holder's last name and the ZIP code where you have service. After that you log in with the email you chose as your Account Email plus your password; the login page can help if you forget either one.

To change your Account Email or password, log in, open Profile at the top right of the screen and update them there. Your account number is printed on your latest statement and shown at the top right of the My Account home page.

extra.intent: Using the WOW! help center, find how many days before a billing period begins you must enroll in AutoPay for that bill to be paid automatically. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: Enroll at least 5 days before the billing period begins.

extra.intent: Find out on the WOW! help pages whether turning on AutoPay stops paper statements, and if not, what you need to turn on. Do not change any settings.

solution.text: No, AutoPay does not stop paper statements; you also need to enroll in Paperless Statements.
